Confirm the device is company-managed or approved BYOD, check MDM enrollment, verify identity, reset device trust, and ask him to sign back into SSO apps [okta_device_change.md#First-line Troubleshooting]. The security policy requires identity verification before a new device can access company systems [security_and_mfa_policy.md#Authentication]. 

Since he has no open tickets, have him verify his identity by video check with his manager, HR, or IT, then reset the factor in Okta Helpdesk and require immediate re-enrollment [mfa_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]. If identity cannot be verified, escalate to IT [mfa_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting].

The VPN access process is covered in the KB article [vpn_access.md#VPN Access]. 

To get VPN access, you need to:

1. Ensure the target actually requires VPN [vpn_access.md#First-line Troubleshooting]
2. Verify MFA and device trust [vpn_access.md#First-line Troubleshooting] 
3. Check your VPN group assignment [vpn_access.md#First-line Troubleshooting]

Note that all accounts use MFA through Okta with no exceptions, and new devices require identity verification before accessing company systems [security_and_mfa_policy.md#Authentication]. If you have trouble, IT can verify your identity by video check, reset your factor in Okta Helpdesk, and require immediate re-enrollment [mfa_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting].

The password reset process follows the same identity verification and MFA requirements as the MFA reset and VPN access processes [password_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]. 

To reset a password:
1. Verify the user's identity by video check with their manager, HR, or IT [password_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]
2. Reset the password via Okta for SSO apps [password_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]  
3. Confirm MFA works after the reset [password_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]
4. Check for any lockout or risky sign-in alerts [password_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]

As with the MFA issue, if identity cannot be verified, escalate to IT [mfa_reset.md#First-line Troubleshooting]. The security policy requires identity verification before allowing access from new devices [security_and_mfa_policy.md#Authentication].

You should work with your manager to gather evidence of recent work that shows patterns of impact, peer input when relevant, and a mapping to the next title level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].
